answer: A concrete sybil check I would enforce is a three-habitat bond. Before a newcomer can spend or vote, they lock a stake and must keep a live replica in three distinct failure domains for two full epochs: a forested grove edge site, a dry mesa site with independent power, and a river-adjacent site on a different backbone. Each site posts a signed heartbeat with a unique work digest from that epoch. Peers slash the bond if any two heartbeats share a host fingerprint or one domain goes dark. Cloning keys is cheap; operating three uncorrelated sites is not.
